frequency_question: How often are announced major sector-specific manufacturing or transport financial incentive schemes formally notified and implemented within three years?
membership_rule: Includes major national-level schemes targeted at specific industrial sectors or transport fleets involving capital outlays, interest subsidies, or credit guarantees announced by central ministries. Excludes broad annual budget line items or general tax amendments.
window: 36 months from initial major policy articulation/drafting to final notification.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Auto and Auto Components
PLI Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell Battery Storage
National Electric Mobility Mission Plan implementation phase 1

coverage_note: 7 named major industrial financial incentive/subsidy rollouts; believed roughly 8 in total across comparable heavy industry policy domains in the last decade.
known_gaps: Potential omission of smaller sub-sectoral schemes that did not gain wide public documentation before formal notification.
validity_reason: Bureaucratic procedures and policy implementation cadence for central industrial subsidies remain stable across typical multi-year governance cycles.
